title: Publishers Weekly Reports on Sharjah’s Global Bookselling Gathering
excerpt: The fifth Sharjah Booksellers Conference welcomed 912 participants representing 99 countries. Publishers Weekly reports on the international gathering and its focus on the future of bookselling.
image_alt: Sharjah Booksellers Conference — image from Publishers Weekly
body:
The fifth Sharjah Booksellers Conference welcomed 912 participants representing 99 countries. Publishers Weekly reports on the international gathering and its focus on the future of bookselling.

The event took place at Expo Centre Sharjah on 19–20 September 2026. Its programme explored how bookshops can reach new readers and strengthen their businesses.

[Read Ed Nawotka’s report in Publishers Weekly](https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/by-topic/international/trade-shows/article/101356-sharjah-booksellers-conference-draws-attendees-from-99-countries.html)

[Read about Epsilon Publishing Group’s participation](../sharjah-booksellers-conference-2026/)
